name: Match a written label to an object
short_description: Match a written label to an object once under stated everyday conditions without assistance.
self_assessment: I can match a written label to an object in one repeatable attempt without help.
description: Match a written label to an object means carrying out this capability under ordinary, stated conditions without another person completing any part. Practice focuses on the observable result, the threshold in the self-assessment, and repeatability across more than one occasion. The capability includes selecting an appropriate approach, completing the action, and checking the outcome. It excludes brand-specific steps, credentials, unrelated habits, and one-off achievements.
examples: Match a written label to an object in a fresh real-life scenario.
